summary: Short-lived GCP service-account impersonation for external diagnostics (BlueFox Labs)
description: Issue summary: BlueFox Labs (external infra vendor) needs timebound, least-privilege impersonation access to a Redwood GCP service account to complete low-level networking and boot diagnostics against our production us-central1 cluster. They will not be given full console access; access should be restricted, auditable, and revoked automatically after the window.
background: BlueFox was engaged for a contract diagnostic to investigate intermittent kernel-level packet drops observed by our Dedicated cluster in us-central1. They require a service account they can impersonate via Workload Identity Federation or a scoped IAM binding to run gcloud-based troubleshooting (log reads, stackdriver trace lookup, compute instance metadata access) and to SSH through an approved bastion host for packet captures. Security requires a JIT/timebound grant and audit trail before we provide any external impersonation capability.
requested_access: Create a dedicated service account ext-diagnostics-bluefox@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com with a narrow IAM bundle: roles/logging.viewer, roles/compute.instanceViewer (read-only), roles/monitoring.viewer, and allow iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken or workload identity impersonation. Bind only to the external principal bluefox-labs-prod@bluefox-oidc. Limit scope via IAM Conditions: resource.project == redwood-prod, request.time within 2026-03-12T14:00Z .. 2026-03-14T14:00Z (48h), and optional source IP ranges for the bastion NAT. Enable detailed audit logging for all serviceAccountTokens and IAMPolicyChange events. Do NOT grant cloudresourcemanager or billing scopes.
justification: Vendor contract requires access to validate kernel/VM-level packet drops and verify NAT/route config. Internal SRE cannot reproduce with our current runbook and need a vendor with specialized tooling. This is timebound and critical to unblock the dedicated cluster uptime workstream.
duration: 2026-03-12 to 2026-03-14 (48 hours); automatic revoke required at end time
risk_mitigation: 1) Timebound window with automated revocation. 2) Restrict impersonation to a single named external OIDC principal. 3) Minimal IAM roles (read-only). 4) Require a support engineer to be on the call while vendor performs actions. 5) Route all actions through existing bastion; block direct console access. 6) Enable audit log sinks to a secured, tamper-evident retention bucket and notify #infra-security channel for the window.
steps_for_validation: 1) After provisioning, SRE will validate by attempting gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=ext-diagnostics-bluefox@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com from an approved host. 2) Verify logs can be read: gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app OR resource.type=gce_instance" --limit 1 --impersonate-service-account=... 3) Confirm compute instance metadata read returns expected instance list. 4) Confirm vendor can SSH to bastion and run tcpdump only after SRE snapshots and live monitors. 5) Confirm audit log entries are present in the secure bucket for each action.
